## AgentAudit Security Audit

**Result: ✅ Safe** (risk score: 0/100)

An automated security audit was performed on this package by [AgentAudit](https://agentaudit.dev). The audit followed a 3-pass process (Understand → Detect → Classify) and found **no security findings**.

### What was checked
- Command injection patterns (exec, eval, subprocess)
- Credential theft / data exfiltration
- Obfuscation / backdoors
- MCP-specific risks (tool poisoning, path traversal, prompt injection)
- Supply chain risks
- Social engineering patterns

### Report
Full report: https://agentaudit.dev/skills/mcp-context-forge

This PR adds an AgentAudit badge to the README indicating the package passed the security audit.
